name: refuse-non-render-surface
description: A REGISTERED code whose surfaces exclude the render gate. It has no render envelope at all, so a conformant projector produces nothing for it. Projecting it anyway is the drift the per-surface namespace rule forbids — this case is what makes that rule observable rather than prose.

refusal.message: an active plan already exists on this app
refusal.fix: cancel the existing plan first, then call again
